w:r.w:t: This document sets out the strategic vision, governance structure, operational alignment, and foundational principles for the development of an AI-powered assurance, audit, and financial compliance platform.

The platform is intended to modernize the way audit firms, accounting professionals, and financial compliance teams manage engagements, audit evidence, documentation, review workflows, and financial reporting processes. The solution aims to combine professional audit methodology with modern cloud technology, automation, artificial intelligence, OCR-based evidence processing, and scalable SaaS architecture.

The initial target market will focus on Myanmar-based audit firms, accounting firms, and selected SME and multinational company (MNC) users. Following successful implementation and market validation, the platform is expected to expand into broader ASEAN and international markets.

The platform is not intended to replicate existing products such as CaseWare or DataSnipper. Instead, those platforms will serve only as workflow and feature references. The objective is to develop a next-generation audit intelligence platform that provides improved usability, AI-assisted workflow automation, stronger evidence intelligence, and more efficient reviewer-centric audit management.
This document establishes the governance and operational foundation before detailed Business Requirement Document (BRD) development and software implementation activities commence.
The platform development initiative is supported by the following aligned entities:
Platform owner, software architect, technology developer, cloud infrastructure manager, and AI integration lead
Myanmar business representative, implementation partner, local commercialization and onboarding coordinator
Audit methodology advisor, pilot user environment, practical workflow validation and user acceptance testing (UAT) contributor

The collaboration among these entities is intended to create a balanced ecosystem combining technical capability, practical audit expertise, commercialization capability, and real-world testing environments.
Studio Next Step Pte. Ltd. will lead all software engineering, architecture, deployment, security, and platform scalability activities.

i Due Care Limited will support local market representation, implementation coordination, client onboarding, support services, training activities, and localized operational requirements within Myanmar.

TZ Assurance CPA Firm will contribute practical audit workflow expertise, audit methodology guidance, testing feedback, quality assurance insights, and real engagement-based user validation to ensure the platform aligns with professional audit practices and user expectations.
The long-term vision of the platform is:
“To become a leading AI-native assurance, audit, and financial compliance operating system for emerging and mid-tier markets globally.”

The platform aims to transform traditional audit operations into intelligent, integrated, evidence-driven workflows that improve audit quality, reviewer efficiency, and professional compliance standards.

The platform is intended to support future expansion beyond external audit into broader assurance and compliance services, including tax, internal audit, ESG reporting, AML compliance, financial reporting automation, and advisory workflows.

The platform is intended to operate as an AI-powered assurance and compliance operating system designed to modernize audit workflows, evidence management, financial reporting, and professional review processes.

The platform branding, identity standards, and trademark registration activities shall be managed separately under the product commercialization and legal governance framework.
The mission of the platform is:

“To enhance professional assurance and financial compliance processes through intelligent workflow management, AI-assisted audit operations, evidence automation, and integrated financial reporting technologies.”

The platform will prioritize operational practicality, professional compliance, usability, scalability, and reviewer efficiency while maintaining alignment with applicable international standards and regulatory requirements.
The initial implementation phase will focus on:
Professional service firms requiring compliance documentation workflows
The initial market selection is based on:
Limited availability of localized audit platforms
Growing demand for digital audit management

AI-assisted drafting, risk identification, review support and workflow suggestions
Automated financial statement preparation and disclosure support
Reviewer workflows, approvals, engagement quality management and signoff control
Dashboards, audit metrics, workflow tracking and management insights
The detailed requirements for each module will be developed separately within the Business Requirement Document (BRD).

This Product Vision & Governance Document establishes the foundational alignment for the development of the platform.

The document defines the strategic direction, governance framework, organizational alignment, operational philosophy, and long-term objectives required before detailed Business Requirement Document (BRD) development begins.

The platform is intended to combine practical audit expertise, intelligent workflow management, AI-assisted operational efficiency, and scalable cloud technology into a unified assurance and compliance ecosystem capable of serving both local and international markets.

Upon approval of this document, the next stage will involve detailed Business Requirement Document (BRD) preparation, workflow mapping, technical architecture planning, and UI/UX specification development.
